Your photo. Your choice.

While live analysis is disconnected, the form previews your photo in your browser. Your name, email, and photo are not sent by the form.

When the analysis service is connected, clicking Analyze sends your name, email, and a resized copy of your photo to Face4’s server. Only the photo is forwarded to OpenAI to generate presentation and styling suggestions. Your email is not sent to OpenAI, used for marketing, or used to deliver email in this implementation.

The prepared Face4 server does not save submissions or reports to a database or log their contents. Your photo and results stay on this page until you reload, leave, or remove the photo. Downloads are saved on your own device.

OpenAI processes submitted photos under its API data policies. The integration disables response storage, but this is not a guarantee of zero provider retention. See OpenAI’s API data controls. Hosting providers may retain operational request metadata.

Use only your own photo and this service only if you are 18 or older. Analysis concerns visible presentation and styling, and may be affected by lighting and camera angle.
